description: This file declares functions related to buffering data on disk for the lighttpd server, specifically functions to create and stop a disk-backed buffer stream.

methods.name: li_filter_buffer_on_disk
methods.description: Creates a disk-based buffer stream with configurable flush limit and chunk splitting behavior.

methods.name: li_filter_buffer_on_disk_stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the disk buffer stream.
